pr.body: Introduces `src/rate-limit.ts`, a per-key in-memory rate limiter.

recorded_model_response.review_markdown:
## Summary

The new `src/rate-limit.ts` limiter is broken: the guard in `allow` compares `current < this.options.windowMs` — a duration in ms — instead of `limit`, so it never trips.

## Findings

- **Blocker** (src/rate-limit.ts:14) — the `allow` guard compares `current < this.options.windowMs` (a duration in milliseconds) instead of `limit`, so the limiter never trips and requests are never throttled.

## Recommendation

Request changes: compare the count against `limit`, not `windowMs`.

findings.message: The `allow` guard compares `current < this.options.windowMs` — a duration in milliseconds — against the running count instead of `limit`, so the limiter never trips and no request is ever throttled.
